# Keywake

Keywake is an original deterministic three-room navigation puzzle. The coral explorer walks one stationary tile at a time: collect each room's brass keys, then enter its gold hatch. The third room rewards choosing the short key order.

## Controls

- Arrow keys: one tile per press.
- Touch: tap one of the four labeled canvas pad columns (LEFT, UP, RIGHT, DOWN).
- Start, Pause, Resume, and Replay use the supplied GameKit lifecycle controls.

Every seed transforms each 3×3 room through rotations and a mirror while preserving its puzzle structure. Legal walking moves are counted for room-clear efficiency; only clearing a room awards score. Replay resets the same deterministic seed through GameKit. Device best is displayed from GameKit's device-local practice state.

The game has no account, network service, external assets, or sound. Reduced-motion preference is observed live: travel interpolation becomes a clear static destination outline.

tests: Load index.html through a local static server with supplied gamekit.js and manifest.json; confirm Start initializes KeywakeCore and canvas input works.
For seeds 1, 7, 23, 89, 2026, and 4294967295, inspect core projections and verify transformed room routes, entry complexities 2/3/4, and terminal success.
Verify touch columns increment pointer_actions and arrow key edges produce one attempted move until released.
Toggle prefers-reduced-motion during a move and inspect KeywakeArt.presentation().
result.summary: Implemented Keywake as an original deterministic three-room key collection navigation puzzle with DOM-free core, responsive canvas presentation, GameKit lifecycle integration, progress/score/best UI, replay controls, and live reduced-motion feedback.

# Keywake

Keywake is an original deterministic route-planning puzzle. Each seed chooses one of six authored vault packs. In every 4×4 room, collect its colored keys, use their matching gate bars, then enter the exit. Only legal steps count, and only clearing a room earns score.

## Controls

- Arrow keys move one cell; release before repeating that direction.
- Tap the canvas columns labeled LEFT, UP, RIGHT, and DOWN to move on touch devices.
- Start, Pause, Resume, and Replay are provided by the supplied GameKit controls.

The route score compares each completed room against its displayed PAR. Replay uses the same seed, making route order and detour reduction repeatable. The displayed device best is supplied by GameKit device-local practice state. The game uses no accounts, external assets, network services, or sound.
